test_smolvlm_image_query: run the pytest integration test that queries the SmolVLM model with an image URL and validates the generated text response
test_smolvlm_generate_tokens: run the pytest test that verifies the SmolVLM model generates exactly 8 tokens for a given image query
test_smolvlm_health_check: run the pytest fixture that launches the SmolVLM-Instruct model and waits for its health endpoint to be ready
test_smolvlm_response_snapshot: run the pytest test that compares the SmolVLM model response against a stored snapshot for regression validation
test_smolvlm_launcher_fixture: run the pytest fixture that launches the HuggingFaceTB SmolVLM-Instruct model using the launcher context manager
